intended_contribution: Runtime proposals and learned selection of whole finite source-body instances and compositions, while the complete primitive point model remains authoritative. This is a genuine cluster action space; a hand-authored recipe ranking feature alone would not implement it.

logical_object.conditional_lemma: An independently checked source derivation establishes the ordered sequent \(\Gamma=(H_0,\ldots,H_{k-1})\vdash C\). Each premise occurrence and leaf command remains visible. It is an available conditional inference family, not a globally admitted conclusion.
logical_object.current_scope: All 171 already checked finite mapped definitions of the guarded incidence fragment. Their fixed theory/signature, declaration identities, source closure, primitive recipe witnesses and formula registry remain frozen. This inventory is not an unrestricted lemma-schema theorem or a universal native Wang palette.
logical_object.pending_receptor: A bound unoccupied row carrying a compatible formula marking is a conditional structural obligation; it is neither a proved hypothesis nor a newly installed assumption. The original three global hypotheses alone may be seeded without an earlier derivation.
logical_object.closure: The conclusion becomes a proved fact only after every logical leaf and reference closes in a globally checked primitive word deriving \(C\) from the original retained \(\Gamma\). No hidden discharge or universal closure.
logical_object.variable_transport: Current registered finite constant maps are authoritative only within their exact declared source/recipient theory relation. Further variable instantiation, new symbols, compound images or new recipes require separate soundness and finite-model exports; do not infer those capabilities from a syntactic matcher.

runtime_family_generation.inventory: Use every one of the 171 registered bodies as eligible source data; never select bodies by target name, expected theorem, known 24-row witness, or a manually chosen successful chain.
runtime_family_generation.bindings: Generate bounded tuples of actual receptor row bindings and strictly increasing internal member rows; reconstruct every primitive key and strict-prior ordered reference from the registered body. Noninjective receptor bindings may merge equal formula codes while retaining each ordered premise/read port; unequal codes at one point reject. Internal member occurrences within one body remain distinct.
runtime_family_generation.physical_embeddings: Current model permits vertical integer translations of individual primitives and independently authorized increasing row embeddings of a source proof DAG, with exact regenerated remote offsets. An arbitrary increasing embedding is a proof-DAG transport, not a single rigid physical translation of one macro tile; report that distinction.
runtime_family_generation.composition: Unify only exact formula interfaces and explicit prior output-to-receptor edges. Retain both component source identities and the complete expanded leaf/port DAG. Reject cycles/forward reads and formula-only sharing. The earliest gate should limit composition depth/size but leave every primitive fallback untouched.
runtime_family_generation.sharing: Across distinct descriptors, deduplicate physical occupancy only for the same full decorated primitive placement: inventory recipe, rebased command, ordered references, transform, exact t/m, context, registry and authority epoch. Preserve all contributing body/occurrence provenance and ordered reader multiplicity. Equal formulas at different placements are not shared.
runtime_family_generation.proposal_bounds: Declare family/binding/composition/embedding proposal limits and enumeration order before execution. Proposal exhaustion or absence never supplies graph degrees, dead ends, forced claims or theorem nonprovability.
runtime_family_generation.pool_epoch: Keep body authority immutable. A bounded root-generated instance pool works with the existing root-fixed controller. Genuine state-adaptive insertion/removal requires a NEW trailed pool protocol or independently justified deterministic per-node reconstruction; existing Controller.checkpoint binds immutable descriptor IDs and will not permit silent dynamic replacement.

controller_and_scheduler.validation: Each descriptor must be exactly an authorized transport of its registered source body, with all recipe witnesses, premise ports, full identities, aggregate marks and epochs independently reconstructed. Individually legal arbitrary members plus a copied body hash are insufficient.
controller_and_scheduler.whole_lifecycle: Waiting/ready/consumed/retired status depends on the whole pending expansion. Retirement is branch-absorbing until paired graph/hint/pool rollback, including stale body/epoch, any remote mark conflict, capacity conflict or excluded member. Consumed/shared members are skipped only after exact identity agreement.
controller_and_scheduler.decision_authority: Whole proposals provide preferences only after global dead and forced propagation and earliest-generation selection. Execute one eligible primitive through the unchanged graph; return to global checks after every primitive step. No atomic macro shortcut, proposal degree substitution or guessed closure.
controller_and_scheduler.complete_fallback: Distinct eligible preferred keys followed by every remaining legal candidate constitute a full permutation of the chosen point domain. Retiring a proposal never removes its still-legal primitive alternatives.
controller_and_scheduler.unknown: Unknown child status, cancellation, memory/time cap and proposal exhaustion authorize no parent exclusion. Exclusion requires a completely reconstructed exhausted finite child in its exact parent context.

learning_protocol.actions: Learn selection/composition of validated family-instance descriptors, with a transparent no-proposal/base-fallback action. Log the selected descriptor, complete offered pool, expanded members, validation outcome and executed primitive eligibility. A stochastic update must actually be applied and independently rederived before calling it RL.
learning_protocol.features: Generic graph/frontier/marking, formula/port and body-size structure; declared goal-formula conditioning is permissible as a structural feature if uniformly encoded. Prohibit hardcoded target names, identity-to-known-proof lookup, target row sequences and authored winning words. Avoid leaking held-out outcome/path metadata through hashes or labels.
learning_protocol.reward: Reward unique newly selected base placements/satisfied required points and verified completion; subtract total search/proposal/validation cost. No reward for macro count or shared leaves counted repeatedly. Unknown is not a negative theorem label. Intermediate graph progress is not proof-discovery gain.
learning_protocol.training: Freeze training problem generator, all seeds, budgets, policy/update rules and all171 library provenance before collection. Train from actual bounded search events, not hand-authored target proof sequences; independently check RNG actions and every update.
learning_protocol.heldout: Freeze disjoint evaluation tasks/seeds/premise patterns/boundaries before training and do not select a winning checkpoint from held-out results. This is RL evaluation, separate from the master local-marking learner requirement to use every resolved catalog sample.
learning_protocol.comparison: Same original target/theory, full primitive universe, fixed markings, scheduler, boundary, attempts/wall/memory and certificate semantics. Compare base, bounded untrained family proposal control and learned family policy; identical candidate pool/library availability where feasible. Disclose any transferred lemma or changed pool/grammar as a language change rather than an RL effect.

independent_gates: Source/pin/AST and prospective bounded gate review, no scientific import/activation.
Pure fixtures for binding/composition/sharing/type/authority and lifecycle, then complete actual source-family reconstruction and every recipe logical interface check.
Full raw-domain and generation/scheduler/whole-lifecycle/paired-pool rollback audit, including every selected preferred+fallback permutation, with no proposal-pool count authority.
Every learned action, RNG draw, reward and weight update checked independently; train versus frozen held-out inputs and costs bound exactly.
Accepted point solution needs complete original required t totals and every assigned m agreement including absent versus zero/exterior/reference counts, plus exact decorated row identities.

Accepted mathematical proof additionally needs every primitive logical command/ordered reference and the unchanged original target from only the retained hypotheses, plus independent flat request reconstruction. Native machine checking remains a separate explicitly authorized gate.
prospective_mutations: A copied valid source body hash with altered but individually legal member keys must fail transport.
Same formula but different recipe/reference/row/authority must fail shared-identity merging; exact shared identities must consume t once while preserving two provenance paths.
Noninjective equal receptor codes must preserve repeated ports; different codes must conflict; boolean row/code/priority must fail exact integer semantics.
A pending marked-empty receptor must never be recorded as proved or installed as a new local hypothesis.
Cycle/forward-reference composition and stale model/source/body/pool epochs must fail.
Whole retirement must remain absorbing during branch changes, revive only on paired rollback, and never delete legal fallback.
Unknown child must restore parent/pool/RNG semantics without exclusion; truly exhausted child may exclude only its exact parent key.
Reward shared leaves twice, mutate saved observation aliases, leak held-out proof words or change an RL update must fail corresponding gates.
cost_scope: Source/design authoring unmeasured. Later proposal construction, full validation, family composition, model/library warmup, learning/replay, held-out search, serialization/reap and review costs must be retained; no free inventory/setup assumption.
